title: platystele johnstonii
intro: Platystele johnstonii, commonly known as the Johnston's Platystele, is a species of orchid. It is a type of epiphytic orchid native to the tropical regions of Central America, specifically in Costa Rica and Panama. The health benefits of Platystele johnstonii include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which could aid in wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
